description: Namespace-isolated MCP call adapter plus gateway catalog and safety policy.

notes: defaultspack owns MCP connection, listing, registry, approval, and execution.
This pack owns only catalog, routing, template, marketplace, and safety metadata.
Unknown MCP servers must remain behind explicit namespace and user approval.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Gateway metadata for unsupported MCP servers must remain opt-in and approval gated.

conflict_notes: This pack does not replace defaults.tool.mcp_connect, defaultspack.tool.mcp_connect, defaults.tool.mcp_list, or defaultspack.tool.mcp_list.
When another pack directly supports an MCP server, prefer that pack over gateway routing.
Unknown servers use mcp_gateway.<server_slug> labels but still rely on runtime approval and defaultspack execution policy.
security_notes: No secrets, credentials, provider endpoints, or ready-to-run connector commands are embedded.
Unsupported MCP servers are denied by default until explicitly reviewed, namespaced, and approved.
Tool calls require the selected MCP executor consumer and an explicit namespace.
